thumbnail.headline: NOT DEAD?
thumbnail.layout: Sol ucte buyuk Mercury (gercek NASA/MESSENGER fotografi, koyulastirilmis ground #05070C uzerine yerlestirilmis), uzerinde kodla cizilmis tek ince amber (#D9A25B) streak vurgusu. Sagda ice-white (#F2F5FF) Inter Medium 'NOT DEAD?': 'DEAD' amber, soru isareti zorunlu. Sag taraf bos ve karanlik; baslik telefonda okunur boyutta. Yuz, logo, ok, kirmizi daire yok.
thumbnail.image_prompt: Real-image-based composition, no AI generation: take a real NASA/JHUAPL/MESSENGER global Mercury image (NASA Image Library, search 'Mercury MESSENGER global'), place it large on the left third over a near-black #05070C ground with a faint code-drawn star-dust layer; add one code-drawn thin muted amber #D9A25B hairline tracing a streak on the planet and one hairline teal #62C2CF orbit arc; keep the right two thirds empty and dark for the headline; no text in the base image, no logos, no spacecraft, no faces.

cover_concepts.headline: NOT DEAD?
cover_concepts.canva_brief: Canvas 1280x720 landscape, ground near-black #05070C. Upload a real NASA/JHUAPL MESSENGER global image of Mercury (find it in the NASA Image Library by searching 'Mercury MESSENGER global'; use the real image, do not generate or paint a look-alike). Place Mercury large and sharp on the left third, slightly cropped by the left edge, with a soft dark gradient into the ground on its right side. Draw one thin muted amber #D9A25B line along a crater slope on the planet as the only highlight, plus one hairline teal #62C2CF orbit arc. Put the headline NOT DEAD? on the right in ice-white #F2F5FF, Inter Medium, very large (cap height at least 120 px) so it stays readable at phone size; colour the word DEAD in amber, and the question mark is mandatory. Mood: quiet, precise, curious, a scientific figure rather than a poster, lots of dark space around the headline. No extra text, no logos, no faces, no arrows, no red shapes, no spacecraft.
cover_concepts.accuracy_note: Soru isareti zorunlu: video 'olu mu?' sorusunu inceliyor, cevap 'henuz bilmiyoruz, sessiz olabilir'; kapak canli iddiasi tasimaz.

cover_concepts.headline: 400 BRIGHT STREAKS
cover_concepts.canva_brief: Canvas 1280x720 landscape, ground near-black #05070C. Upload a real NASA MESSENGER image of a Mercury crater as the base (NASA Image Library, search 'Mercury crater bright streaks' or 'Mercury crater MESSENGER'; use the real image, never a generated look-alike), darkened to about 40 percent brightness and placed on the right half with a fade into the dark ground on its left. Add three or four thin muted amber #D9A25B hairline circles around streaks on the crater slope. On the left set the figure 400 very large in ice-white #F2F5FF, Inter Medium (or Light), with the words BRIGHT STREAKS beneath it at a smaller but still phone-readable size; add a tiny grey line 'about, in MESSENGER images' only if it stays legible. A thin teal #62C2CF hairline rule sits between figure and words. Mood: sober, measured, a figure from a dataset, not an alarm. No extra text, no logos, no faces. Write the number as 400 and keep 'about' in the small line, never round it up.
cover_concepts.accuracy_note: Rakam senaryoda 'about four hundred bright streaks' (Bern ekibi, MESSENGER goruntuleri, S4); yuvarlanmadi, 'about' kucuk satirda.

cover_concepts.headline: Mercury, Revisited
cover_concepts.canva_brief: Canvas 1280x720 landscape, ground near-black #05070C with a very faint star-dust texture. One subject only: a small Mercury in the lower left, either a real NASA MESSENGER Mercury image (NASA Image Library, search 'Mercury MESSENGER portrait') cut cleanly onto the ground, or a plain code-drawn teal #62C2CF circle outline if no clean cut is available; never a generated look-alike. A single hairline teal orbit arc enters from the upper right and a tiny muted amber #D9A25B dot sits on it. Headline 'Mercury, Revisited' in ice-white #F2F5FF, Inter Medium, in the upper left, large enough to read on a phone. Under it a thin grey hairline, nothing else. Leave at least 60 percent of the frame empty and dark; the mood is the channel's quiet, precise look. No extra text, no logos, no faces.
cover_concepts.accuracy_note: Video MESSENGER'in eski verisini BepiColombo'nun yeni gelisiyle yeniden ele aliyor; kapak yalniz bu cercevede, yeni bir bulgu iddia etmez.

design_notes: Overlay sayisi bilerek az (12): yalnizca anahtar rakam ve temkin cumleleri. Hepsi 64 px ve ustu, %10 guvenli kenar icinde, alt ucuncuda ya da merkezde; fotograf/video uzerinde yumusak koyu scrim kullanilir. Sema (cizim) sahnelerinde schematic_brief zaten ayni rakami ciziyorsa (ornegin 9, 12, 25, 31) overlay atlanir ya da cizimle cakismayacak sekilde alt ucuncuda tutulur; cizim etiketleri 36 px ustu. Delil sayaci yalniz evidence_update=true sahnelerinde (3, 8, 16, 22, 35, 45), sol ustte, birkac saniye sonra kapanir; sahne 8'de sayac ve alt ucuncu overlay cakismaz. Kapak: ana oneri NOT DEAD? (soru isareti zorunlu), alternatif 400 BRIGHT STREAKS (script'teki 'about four hundred'), yedek Mercury, Revisited. Hicbir kapak ya da gorsel AI ile uretilmez; gercek NASA/MESSENGER gorseli ya da kodla cizilmis grafik kullanilir. Sahne planinda nasa_id alani yok; sahibi NASA Image Library'de brief'teki arama ifadesiyle gercek goruntuyu secer. BepiColombo sahneleri kodla cizilen 'Illustration' etiketli semalardir.
